query:
SELECT u.id, u.email, u.name, u.role, d.id as dealer_id, d.name as dealer_name, d.subscriptionStatus, d.subscriptionExpiresAt, d.isVerified
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN dealers d ON u.id = d.userId
WHERE u.email = 'anthony.m.perry@gmail.com'
LIMIT 1;
